value.text: Got it! Here's the plan for Ada's swim registration. Registration opens Tuesday, December 1, 2026 at 7:00 p.m. (Eastern time), and Hale will join the line then. First choice is Preschool Swim Sun 10:00, second is Preschool Swim Sat 9:00, each $98. Hale will take the first one that still has a spot, pay only with the card saved on your city account, and spend no more than $110. Hale will also tick the activity waiver at checkout, as you said. If there's no saved card, the site asks for a security code, the total is over your maximum, or a captcha comes up, Hale will stop and leave the cart for you. One thing to know: if you also queue on your own phone or computer, your family holds two places in line, and the town's queue counts that as more than one place. Hale will tell you how it went once registration opens.
